title: Introduce a code search seam (ICodeSearchService) and chunking-strategy adapters
description:
Audit #9, candidate 5 - Worth exploring.

### Problem
CodeSearchService (3,115 lines) has no interface anywhere: McpController, ChatToolCatalog, and even ChatToolExecutionContext.CodeSearch depend on the concrete class. Ten responsibilities co-locate: hybrid search (258-424), index builds (503-752), five chunking strategies (Roslyn / TreeSitter / Markdown / heuristic / fixed-window, 812-1368), embedding batches, its own SQLite schema, shard merge, build log/telemetry. Callers cannot be tested without real code search against temp directories. Incident precedent: MemorySmith.Benchmarks broke CI for weeks when the concrete constructor widened underneath it.

### Approach
1. Introduce ICodeSearchService at the four entry points callers use (SearchAsync, GetStatusAsync, EnsureIndexedAsync, MergeShardAsync); register via explicit factory; update ChatToolExecutionContext to carry the interface
2. Promote the five TryBuild*Chunks strategies to adapters behind an IChunkingStrategy seam (five adapters day one)
3. Optional follow-up: split storage/build-log concerns once the seams exist

### Acceptance criteria
- McpController / ChatToolCatalog / benchmarks depend only on the interface
- Catalog and MCP tests can substitute a fake code search (no temp-dir indexing)
- Chunking strategies independently unit-testable; existing CodeSearchServiceTests stay green
- Sequencing note: do the ChatToolExecutionContext field swap together with TSK-0286 if both land near each other
